I thrive at the intersection of data and innovation, turning raw insights into strategic advantages for forward-thinking organizations. My mission is to build systems that scale, adapt, and deliver measurable impact—because data shouldn’t just be collected, it should drive decisions.  

As a Data Engineer at Weber Consulting, I architect end-to-end data solutions for clients across fintech and healthcare. My focus? Automating workflows with Apache Airflow, orchestrating real-time data streams via Kafka, and transforming messy datasets into actionable intelligence using Spark. I’ve also pioneered data warehousing strategies in Snowflake, slashing query latency by 40% for a Fortune 500 client.  

Last year, I redesigned a legacy ETL pipeline, reducing processing time by 60% and slashing infrastructure costs. I also led a migration to dbt, streamlining data modeling and boosting team productivity. My work? Always rooted in automation, reliability, and results.  

I’m hunting for challenges that push the edge of what’s possible—ideally with teams that value execution as much as vision. Let’s build something that matters.
